desc: Implement tree DP: For each node, compute `dp[u][0..4]` where `dp[u][c]` is the max size of a subtree at `u` with `c` children connected, using `dp[v][0]` from children.
Handle edge cases: If a node has fewer than 4 children, `dp[u][4]` is invalid.
Compute the global maximum of `dp[r][4]` across all nodes.
If no valid `dp[r][4]` exists, output -1; otherwise, output the maximum.
Read input, build adjacency list, run DFS from root (node 1), and print result.
